name: Jacksonville

zoning_layer.note: City of Jacksonville 'Duval County Parcels' map service (CityBiz/Parcels). It is a parcel layer, 409,714 rows, with the zoning code on each parcel in ZON_LABEL and the RE number in RE. No token needed. Max 2,000 records per request. The city's zoning polygon services (BaseLine, DuvalMaps folders) need a token, so this parcel layer is the free source. 48 distinct ZON_LABEL values on 2026-11-17, including RLD100A and RLD100B (no hyphen), RR-Acre, PUD and a blank.

overlay_layers.note: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer, special flood hazard areas, the copy Esri hosts for free (FEMA's own server, hazards.fema.gov NFHL MapServer/28, returned HTTP 500 or reset the connection on 2026-11-19). Clipped to the city's parcel extent. Earlier note: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer, flood hazard zones. Duval is DFIRM_ID 12031C. Tested with a point query. The server dropped 2 of 4 requests during testing; retry on failure.
Same city parcel layer. FLD_ZONE lists every FEMA zone touching the parcel, comma separated.

National Park Service, National Register of Historic Places polygons. Tested: returns Riverside, Avondale, Springfield, Old Ortega, Durkee Gardens, Eastside and Downtown Jacksonville districts. These are National Register boundaries; the city's local historic district boundaries were not found as a free layer.
Same city parcel layer. Fields APZ, AICUZ, CVLSCHZ, MLTSCHZ and the notice fields mark airport and military zones (Part 10 of the Zoning Code). Field meanings not confirmed.

permit_source.note: Jacksonville issues permits through JaxEPICS. It has search screens and daily, monthly and annual statistical reports, but no bulk download or documented public API was found. Its API host returned 403 and its report server could not be reached on 2026-11-17. Older data is by records request only, which is out of scope. Fallback for new construction: year built in the Florida DOR parcel roll.

disclaimer: Estimates, not tax, legal, zoning or appraisal advice.
